202 Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning successfully launches the scan.
403
Returned if you do not have either user permissions to launch the scan or scan permissions to use the
scan configuration. For more information, see Roles and Permissions.
404 Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning cannot find the specified scan configuration.
409 Returned if a scan is already is a running for the specified configuration.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable Web App Scanning.
